text:
jordan: Hey team — quick Q. My stepson turned 26 on Jan 10 but is still enrolled in 9 credits this semester. We missed the open enrollment change and payroll already stopped taking dependent premium in Feb. Can we request a retroactive enrollment for Jan+Feb until docs are finalized?

linda (People Ops): Hi Jordan — sorry for the scramble. Is this a student status continuation or guardianship situation? The process differs slightly.

jordan: It's student status continuation (undergrad part-time). We have the registrar letter pending; will upload within the week. Payroll already adjusted, so worried about premium differences/refunds.

sam (Benefits): If you can get the school letter confirming at least 6 credits during the semester that covers Jan 1–Mar 31, we can consider a midyear exception. Upload to the secure portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/upload and mark it "dependent-proof." Accepted: registrar enrollment letter, tuition invoice showing credits, or student ID + schedule PDF.

alex (Payroll): For retroactive premium adjustments: if Benefits approves a retro-add, payroll will calculate premium owed or refund for Jan+Feb. We usually do a payroll correction on the next cycle; small balances are netted into the next paycheck. If amount > $200, we issue a separate adjustment.

jordan: Great — thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) Do I need to submit a QLE form? 2) Any deadline to request retro coverage?

linda (People Ops): 1) Yes, please submit the QLE form in Workday and choose "Dependent status change — student verification". 2) We aim to process retro requests within 30 days of docs received, but for cases where payroll already changed we try to expedite. Try to upload docs by end of week to hit this window.

jordan: Uploading now...

hr-upload-bot: DOC_RECEIVED: doc_8675309.pdf uploaded by jordan at 1945679105. Status: pending manual review.

sam (Benefits): Got it — I'll review once the doc is unredacted. Quick checklist for you: 
- QLE form submitted in Workday (screenshot helps)
- Registrar letter with term dates and credit load
- Copy of dependent's date of birth (if not already on file)
Once I confirm, I'll route to Payroll for the correction.

jordan: Thanks Sam — submitted QLE and screenshot. Also attached DOB. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup: 

alex (Payroll): Noted. If Benefits approves today, payroll can process the correction in tomorrow's run; otherwise next cycle. I'll post here when adjustment is queued.

sam (Benefits): Reviewing now — one small thing: the registrar letter shows 5 credits for spring. We need 6+ for full-time dependent eligibility. Can you ask registrar for the official add/drop confirmation or provide a tuition invoice that shows 6 credits?

jordan: Ah dang, will request the invoice. Should be easy.

linda (People Ops): If there's any delay, we can still keep the request open and make a provisional approval contingent on the invoice within 7 days. That way payroll knows to hold off on finalizing the refund.

jordan: Okay will follow up — thanks all.

hr-upload-bot: DOC_RECEIVED: invoice_spring2026.pdf uploaded by jordan at 1945679500. Status: pending manual review.

sam (Benefits): Received invoice — shows 6 credits. I'm approving the retro-add for Jan 1–Feb 28 pending HR sign-off. I'll update after final sign-off.

alex (Payroll): Once final approved, I'll post the expected adjustment amount and payroll date.

jordan: Huge help — really appreciate the quick responses.

linda (People Ops): No problem. I'll close the QLE in Workday after approval and add a note about the retro period. If anything changes, we'll loop you back in. :white_check_mark:
